title: Evince
summary: EVINCE, verb transitive evins'. [Latin evinco, to vanquish, to prove or show; e and vinco, to conquer.] 1. To show in a clear manner; to prove beyond any reasonable doubt; to manifest; to make evident

inlines.v: EVINCE, verb transitive evins'. [Latin evinco, to vanquish, to prove or show; e and vinco, to conquer.] 1. To show in a clear manner; to prove beyond any reasonable doubt; to manifest; to make evident. Nothing evinces the depravity of man more fully than his unwillingness to believe himself depraved. 2. To conquer. [Not in use.]
